**UI Audit: EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free (Scanning State)**

### 1) LAYOUT
*   **Window Bounds:** 1024x768px (Maximized, standard Windows 11 chrome).
*   **Header Bar (0–75px):**
    *   **Left:** App Icon + Title ("EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free") [10, 15].
    *   **Center-Left:** Navigation Breadcrumbs/Toolbar (Home, Back, Forward, Up, Current Path "Windows (C:)") [20, 70] to [350, 110].
    *   **Right:** Action Cluster. "Buy Now" button (Orange), Target Disk icon, Info icon, Hamburger Menu, Window Controls (Min, Max, Close) [680, 10] to [990, 45].
    *   **Sub-header:** View Toggles (List), "Filter" button, Search Bar ("Search files or folders") [650, 70] to [985, 110].
*   **Main Body (Split Pane) (75–795px):**
    *   **Sidebar (Tree View) (0–275px):** Contains "Path"/"Type" tabs at top. List of scan targets (Windows C:, File Path Lost, Reconstructed) with item counts.
    *   **File List (Center) (275–795px):** Table with columns: Checkbox, Name (Sortable), Date Modified, Type.
    *   **Preview Pane (Right) (795–1024px):** Shows details for selected folder ("actionarchivecache"): Folder icon, Name, "Open" button, Metadata (Size, Date Modified, Path). Floating "AI Smart Finder" icon at bottom right.
*   **Status / Progress Footer (795–855px):**
    *   **Top Strip (Blue):** Scanning status text (marquee/path).
    *   **Bottom Strip (White):** Circular Gauge (21%), Status Text ("Scan Paused..."), Control Buttons (Play/Pause, Stop), Timer, "Recover All..." CTA.
*   **Taskbar (855–768px):** Windows 11 Taskbar (Centered icons, System Tray, Clock).

### 2) TEXT (Verbatim)
*   **Header:** "EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free"
*   **Button (Top Right):** "Buy Now"
*   **Button (Toolbar):** "Filter"
*   **Search Placeholder:** "Search files or folders"
*   **Path/Breadcrumb:** "Windows (C:)"
*   **List Headers:** "Name", "Date Modified", "Type"
*   **Sidebar Tabs:** "Path", "Type"
*   **Sidebar Items:**
    *   "Windows (C:)" | "1.1M"
    *   "File Path Lost" | "4.3K"
    *   "Reconstructed" | "6"
*   **List Items (Sample):**
    *   "actionarchivecache" | "10/7/2026 11:30 PM" | "File folder"
    *   "actions-runner" | "10/17/2026 6:11 PM" | "File folder"
    *   "azureCli" | "10/8/2026 1:50 AM" | "File folder"
    *   ... (others follow same pattern)
*   **Preview Pane:**
    *   "actionarchivecache"
    *   "Open"
    *   "Size" | "7.29 MB"
    *   "Date Modified" | "10/7/2026 11:30 PM"
    *   "Path" | "C:\"
*   **Status Bar (Blue Strip):** "Searching: ...\0003000000A9F90197D9D80\Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Scripting.resources.dll"
*   **Status Bar (Main):**
    *   "Scan Paused , Files found: **1139163** (146.29 GB)"
    *   "Scanning Paused." (Red text)
    *   "Reading sector: 62464000/313413598"
*   **Button (Footer):** "Recover All ..."
*   **System Clock:** "6:17 PM", "10/17/2026"

### 3) COLOR
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   App Background: `#F5F8FA` (Light Blue-Grey, ESTIMATED)
    *   Sidebar/List Item Hover: `#E1F0FF` (Light Blue, ESTIMATED)
    *   Selected Item (List): `#CBE2FF` (Darker Light Blue, ESTIMATED)
    *   Preview Pane BG: `#FFFFFF` (White, ESTIMATED)
    *   Status Strip Top: `#B3D9FF` (Light Blue, ESTIMATED)
    *   Status Strip Bottom: `#FFFFFF` (White, ESTIMATED)
*   **Accents & Text:**
    *   Primary Brand Blue: `#2D8CF0` (Buttons, Links, Gauge, ESTIMATED)
    *   Buy Now Button: `#FAAD14` (Orange/Yellow, ESTIMATED)
    *   Text Primary: `#333333` (Dark Grey, ESTIMATED)
    *   Text Secondary: `#666666` or `#888888` (Grey for metadata, ESTIMATED)
    *   Error/Warning Text: `#FF4D4F` (Red for "Scanning Paused", ESTIMATED)
    *   Border/Lines: `#E0E0E0` (Light Grey, ESTIMATED)

### 4) TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Font Family:** Segoe UI (Standard Windows).
*   **Window Title:** ~9pt, Regular.
*   **Headers (List/Sidebar):** ~12pt, Semibold (or Bold).
*   **Body Text (List Items):** ~11pt, Regular.
*   **Metadata (Dates/Sizes):** ~10pt, Regular, lighter color.
*   **Status Bar Text:** ~11pt, Regular.
*   **Gauge Percentage:** ~18pt, Bold.

### 5) SPACING & SIZING
*   **Row Height (List):** ~42px.
*   **Icon Size (List/Folder):** 24x24px or 32x32px.
*   **Circular Gauge:** Diameter ~60px. Stroke width ~6px.
*   **Padding:**
    *   List Item Left Padding: ~10px.
    *   Preview Pane Padding: ~20px.
    *   Header Height: ~50px.
    *   Subheader Height: ~50px.
*   **Gutters:**
    *   Sidebar width: ~270px.
    *   Preview Pane width: ~230px.
*   **Border Radius:**
    *   Buttons: ~4px or ~6px (Slightly rounded).
    *   Search Bar: ~4px.
    *   Gauge: Circle.

### 6) CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Search Box:** Normal state, placeholder visible.
*   **Tabs (Path/Type):** "Path" is Active (Underlined or highlighted background).
*   **Tree View (Sidebar):** "Windows (C:)" is Expanded (Down arrow). Other items collapsed.
*   **List View:**
    *   Row 1 ("actionarchivecache"): **Selected** state (Blue background).
    *   Checkboxes: Unchecked, square.
*   **Progress Gauge:** **Paused** state (Static arc at 21%).
*   **Buttons:**
    *   **Play (Triangle):** Enabled (implies action to Resume).
    *   **Stop (Square):** Enabled.
    *   **Recover All ...:** Primary Action Button (Blue fill, white text), Enabled.
    *   **Open (Preview):** Secondary Button (Blue outline/fill), Enabled.
*   **Status Indicators:**
    *   "Scanning Paused." text is Red (Alert state).

### 7) ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, Outline + Filled mix (Fluent Design style).
*   **Navigation:** Home (House), Arrows (Back/Forward/Up).
*   **Actions:**
    *   Filter (Funnel).
    *   Search (Magnifying Glass).
    *   List View (Hamburger lines).
    *   Play (Triangle inside circle/square).
    *   Stop (Square).
    *   Close (X).
*   **File Types:** Generic Folder Icon (Yellow/Blue variants).
*   **Status:** Clock/Timer icon next to Recover button? (Looks like a clock/history icon).

### 8) STATE
*   **Page State:** **PARTIAL / PAUSED**.
    *   The scan has been running (found 1.1M files, 146GB data) but is currently **Paused**.
    *   The user can interact with the file list (browsing found files while paused).
    *   The progress bar is static at 21%.
    *   The "Scanning Paused" text confirms the halt in the background process.
